thread:
SupportLead: Heads up — Sales has two customers asking for a set of integrations: async Python SDK + batching, Terraform provider for Dedicated, and SCIM/SSO provisioning sync.
SalesRep_Jen: Customer A (fintech) needs SCIM + group sync urgently. Customer B (marketplace) wants Terraform for infra-as-code. Both mentioned willingness to pay for priority.
Product_PM_Maya: Ok, let's formalize scope and acceptance criteria. Proposed backlog tags: integration/python-sdk, integration/terraform, integration/sso-scim, security-review, customer-paid. Thoughts?
EngLead_Ravi: Feasibility quick notes: async Python client + batching ~ 2 sprints (3 engineer sprints including perf work), Terraform provider MVP ~ 3 sprints (owner + infra CI), SCIM v2 endpoints + group sync ~ 2 sprints but security gating needed.
DevEx_Aaron: Docs estimate: 0.5 sprint for SDK async examples + migration guide; 0.5 for Terraform examples & registry listing; 0.5 for SCIM runbook.
EngSecurity_Liz: SCIM will need KMS/HSM integration verification and audit logging on provision events. Add security-review tag; threat model + controls likely 1 sprint.
Product_PM_Maya: Proposed launch MVP scope:
- Python SDK: AsyncClient (asyncio), optional batching API, perf target (95p single-request <150ms).
- Terraform: provider v0.1 create/update/destroy for Dedicated app bindings; examples for registry.
- SCIM: SCIM v2 provisioning endpoints, group sync, audit logs, token rotation endpoint.
SalesRep_Jen: Can we give customers a timeline? They asked for SDK in ~3 weeks, Terraform+SCIM MVP in ~8–10 wks.
EngLead_Ravi: Realistic: SDK in 3 weeks if we prioritize; Terraform and SCIM in parallel across squads — target 8 weeks for MVP. Need owners and epics.
Product_PM_Maya: Owners proposed: @aaron SDK, @ravi Terraform, @liz security & SCIM coordination, @marta infra/CI for provider. I'll coordinate customer comms.
DevEx_Aaron: I'll draft API pattern. Preliminary surface:
```
class AsyncClient:
    async def batch_generate(self, requests: List[Payload]) -> List[Response]:
        """Batched send preserving per-request metadata and ordering."""
```
Will include migration guide from sync client and sample asyncio usage.
EngInfra_Marta: Terraform provider must have CI e2e against Dedicated staging. We'll need a `redwood/terraform-provider` registry entry and packaging steps. I'll own CI checklist.
Product_PM_Maya: Launch checklist (MVP minimum):
- SDK: PyPI package, release notes, migration guide, basic perf tests
- Terraform: provider v0.1, examples, registry listing, provider e2e tests
- SCIM: v2 endpoints, provisioning docs, audit logs enabled, token rotation
- Security: threat model sign-off, KMS checks
- Console: SCIM toggle in org settings (MVP: mapping via JSON upload only)
- Support: runbook + troubleshooting steps
- Legal/Sales: SOW template and pricing for expedited work
SupportLead: Add `customer-comm` step — we'll send preliminary timeline and pricing for approval. Also propose a shared beta Slack channel when we have an alpha.
EngSecurity_Liz: SCIM MVP requires audit events for Create/Update/Delete user/group, and token rotation endpoint. We'll need to validate audit retention and export paths.
Product_PM_Maya: Backlog tags to attach to epics/tickets: integration/python-sdk, integration/terraform, integration/sso-scim, security-review, customer-paid, prio:commercial.
EngLead_Ravi: Rough Jira story points: SDK 8, Terraform 13, SCIM 8, Security review 3, Docs 3. I'll create epics and link customer tickets.
TriageBot: Tickets created: INTEG-5481 (python-sdk-async), INTEG-5482 (terraform-provider-mvp), INTEG-5483 (scim-mvp).
Product_PM_Maya: Next actions:
- @aaron: SDK RFC + PRD by EOD Thu
- @ravi: Terraform RFC + infra checklist by Mon
- @liz: security checklist + KMS audit plan by Mon
- @marta: provider CI plan by Mon
I'll own coordination and customer updates; Support will own SOW comms.
DevEx_Aaron: Will include migration snippets, batching best-practices, and small benchmark harness.
SalesRep_Jen: I'll start SOW outreach and loop customers into a beta channel when we have an alpha.
SupportLead: Once epics exist, we'll open a shared Slack channel for customer beta testing and feedback.
Product_PM_Maya: Marking triage complete for now. Reopen if priorities or SOWs change. :white_check_mark:
